name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for the photos app: a gallery backed up to the user's own private GitHub repos, offline first
_comment_home: The photos SDK (gallery, memories, places, people; factory#262) does not exist yet. When it lands it is added here as the home_sdk, reaching depot through its own domain/interface contract plus a host adapter (ADR-005). Until then this profile composes with base's default home plus depot's /depot/setup and /depot/files, which is enough to test sign-in, backup and the repo-side jobs.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/dart/install.py at core@344e5a6; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Shared kernel: app shell templates, AppStyle, BundledTranslations (depot registers its English copy there at boot) and the AppDatabase depot_sdk registers its six tables into. The photos app has no Frappe backend, so base's gateway is never the storage remote.

sdks.name: depot_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of depot/dart/install.py at hardware@3b579b4; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Storage on the user's own private GitHub repos (depot/CONTRACT.md): device-flow GitHub sign-in, batched commits, index, versions, offline queue, repo-side jobs. The host passes DepotConfig(thumbnails: true, suggestedRepoName: 'my-photos') with the clientId of the GitHub OAuth app (device flow enabled). Not the home: the photos SDK will be. Photos also needs a Google sign-in for the Photos Picker scope to start a Google Photos import (runJob('import', pickerSession, googleToken)); the token is short-lived and passed as a masked dispatch input, never stored in the repo.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/dart/install.py at core@344e5a6; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every profile: delivery policy on top of base_sdk's TelemetryClient.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of auth/dart/install.py at Users@8fc635b; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The app account, separate from the GitHub sign-in that only connects storage (depot's /depot/setup). With no backend, registration and login work offline (auth_sdk's offline users), so the app never blocks on a server. Requires users_sdk at runtime.

sdks.name: users_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of users/dart/install.py at Users@8fc635b; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Required by auth_sdk at runtime (the signed-in user's profile); not optional while auth_sdk is composed.

sdks.name: onboarding_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of onboarding/dart/install.py at Users@8fc635b; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: First-run intro (/onboarding-intro) before the app account; owner ruling 2026-10-13: onboarding is included in the photos app.

sdks.name: desktop_sdk
sdks._comment: TEMPORARY (desktop testing convenience, revert candidate): added to every app profile so all composed apps pull desktop support and can be viewed/tested on desktop. Pin = sha256 of hardware desktop/dart/install.py at main head 84aa6ed, same value as supacharge.json's entry.

sdks.name: hms_sdk
sdks._comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk (SDK module, not productFlavors). Dart-side: DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and an order-30 boot hook that, ONLY on GMS-free HMS-capable devices, boots Push Kit and registers the HMS push token through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses (provider 'hms'). No installs - the BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect Gradle wiring lives statically in core's android template, default-off. Strict no-op in every plain GMS build.
